panels.label: Steering
panels.description: Lateral control, lane changes, and steering behavior

items.title: Enable Modular Assistive Driving System (MADS)
items.description: Enable MADS. This changes how lateral assist is engaged and disengaged. Disable toggle to revert back to stock sunnypilot engagement/disengagement.

items.title: Toggle with Main Cruise
items.description: Allow the main cruise control to toggle MADS engagement. Note: For vehicles without LFA/LKAS button, disabling this will prevent lateral control engagement.

items.title: Unified Engagement Mode (UEM)
items.description: Engage lateral and longitudinal control with cruise control engagement. UEM changes when lateral assist starts. Note: Once lateral control is engaged via UEM, it will remain engaged until it is manually disabled via the MADS button or car shut off.

items.title: Steering Mode on Brake Pedal
items.description: Choose how Automatic Lane Centering (ALC) behaves after the brake pedal is manually pressed in sunnypilot. Disengage is the most conservative choice; Remain Active keeps lateral assist available after braking.

sections.title: Blinker Control
sections.description: Lateral pause behavior during turn signals

items.title: Pause Lateral Control with Blinker
items.description: Pause lateral control with blinker when traveling below the selected speed. Lateral assist resumes after the blinker ends and the post-blinker delay has elapsed.

sub_items.title: Minimum Speed to Pause Lateral Control
sub_items.description: Below this speed, using the blinker can temporarily pause lateral assist. Set to 0 to allow the pause at any speed.

sub_items.title: Post-Blinker Delay
sub_items.description: Delay before lateral control resumes after the turn signal ends. Increase if re-engagement feels too abrupt after signaling.

sections.title: Torque Control
sections.description: Steering torque tuning and lateral control method

items.title: Enforce Torque Lateral Control
items.description: Use Torque lateral control instead of the platform default. This changes steering response and lane-centering feel; turn it off to return to the default controller.

items.title: Neural Network Lateral Control (NNLC)
items.description: Use the neural-network lateral controller when supported. This changes steering behavior; turn it off to return to the default lateral controller.

items.title: Self-Tune
items.description: Enables self-tune for Torque lateral control for platforms that do not use Torque lateral control by default. Learned values can change steering response over time; disable to stop learning and return to fixed/offline torque tuning.

items.title: Speed-Aware Curve
items.description: Choose how learned speed correction is used. Apply mode can change steering response by speed; Off returns to the base torque tune.

items.title: Low-Speed Shadow Collection
items.description: Monitor only — collects low-speed steering data; no driving changes.

items.title: Roll Compensation Gain
items.description: Learn how much extra torque is needed to hold lane on roads with crown or cross-slope. Monitor only mode collects data without changing steering; Apply learned gain can change steering response on crowned roads; turn Off to stop learning.

items.title: Less Restrict Settings for Self-Tune (Beta)
items.description: Less strict settings when using Self-Tune. This allows torqued to be more forgiving when learning values, but may accept noisier steering data. Disable to return to stricter learning.

items.title: Enable Custom Tuning
items.description: Enables custom tuning for Torque lateral control. Modifying Lateral Acceleration Factor and Friction below will override the offline values indicated in the YAML files within "opendbc/car/torque_data". The values will also be used live when "Manual Real-Time Tuning" toggle is enabled. Large changes can bias steering or degrade tracking; turn this off to return to the selected tune.

items.title: Manual Real-Time Tuning
items.description: Enforces the torque lateral controller to use the fixed values instead of the learned values from Self-Tune. Enabling this toggle applies the custom values live and overrides Self-Tune values. Monitor steering response and disable to return to learned/offline values.

items.title: Lateral Acceleration Factor
items.description: Adjusts how strongly torque maps to lateral acceleration. In Real-Time mode this can affect steering immediately; revert by disabling Manual Real-Time Tuning or Custom Tuning.

items.title: Friction
items.description: Adjusts friction compensation for torque steering. In Real-Time mode this can affect steering immediately; revert by disabling Manual Real-Time Tuning or Custom Tuning.

items.title: Torque Control Tune Version
items.description: Select the Torque Control Tune version. Changes apply to torque steering behavior; return to Default to use the standard tune.

sections.title: Lane Change
sections.description: Automatic lane change timing and behavior

items.title: Auto Lane Change by Blinker
items.description: Set a timer to delay the auto lane change operation when the blinker is used. No nudge on the steering wheel is required to auto lane change if a timer is set. Default is Nudge.
items.details: This changes when the car may initiate a lane change after signaling. Please use caution and only use the blinker when traffic and road conditions permit. Set to Off or Nudge to require more driver input.

items.title: Auto Lane Change: Delay with Blind Spot
items.description: Toggle to enable a delay timer for lane changes when blind spot monitoring (BSM) detects a vehicle in your blind spot. This delays the lane-change attempt; it does not replace checking mirrors and traffic.

items.title: Custom Lateral Demand
items.description: Process the driving model's steering curvature (quality gating + smoothing) before lateral control. Fail-closed to the stock curvature and still bounded by existing controller limits; off uses the stock model curvature. This can change the requested lane-centering path, so keep it off if tracking looks worse.

sub_items.title: Lane Centering Assist
sub_items.description: Nudge the processed model path toward the lane center when lane-line confidence is usable. Requires Custom Lateral Demand. Turn it off if the car appears to bias away from the intended lane position.

sub_items.title: Straight Path Stabilization
sub_items.description: Anchor the requested curvature near straight roads to reduce small lane-centering wiggles. Monitor only computes the candidate without changing steering; Apply uses it live. Keep off unless straight-road tracking feels busy.

options.label: Apply
options.description: Live anchoring may straighten the requested path on gentle curves; watch lane-centering behavior and switch to Monitor only if tracking degrades.

sub_items.title: Lane Center Rate Damping
sub_items.description: Monitor only has no driving changes. Apply can change the requested lateral path by damping small lane-center motion before the controller sees it.

sub_items.title: Lane Fit Source Swap
sub_items.description: Monitor only has no driving changes. Apply can change the requested lateral path by swapping to conservative lane-line-center curvature when lane geometry is high-confidence.

sub_items.title: One-Line Lane Centering
sub_items.description: Estimate lane center from a single confident lane line plus recently-learned lane width when the other line is not detected. Monitor only logs the would-be centering nudge with no driving changes. Apply lets the existing lane centering assist use the one-line estimate with its normal caps and deadbands.

sub_items.title: Lateral Preview Assist
sub_items.description: Lateral-only preview of the requested path. Monitor only has no driving changes. Apply can change the requested lateral path with a conservative preview nudge.

sub_items.title: Corner Curve Memory
sub_items.description: Remember a corner's curvature seen at speed and hold it through low-speed stops so the car resumes the turn instead of forgetting it. Supplement-only and vetoed by confident vision; requires Custom Lateral Demand. Turn it off if stop-and-go turns feel over-predicted.

panels.label: Cruise
panels.description: Longitudinal control, speed limits, and cruise behavior

items.title: Dynamic Experimental Control
items.description: Let the model decide when to use sunnypilot ACC or sunnypilot End to End Longitudinal. This can change acceleration and braking behavior; turn it off to keep the selected longitudinal mode. Superseded by the custom Longitudinal Policy's SCC mode, so it is disabled while Custom Longitudinal is on.

items.title: Lead Anticipation
items.description: Monitor lead smoothing in the planner or apply it to the MPC lead input. Apply mode can change following and braking response; Off returns to the base lead input. Apply requires Custom Longitudinal and is disabled when longitudinal is off.

items.title: Dynamic Follow Gap
items.description: Monitor a bounded follow-gap compression during low-risk approaches to a slower lead, or apply it to the MPC follow distance. Apply mode can reduce following distance (never below 1.2 s) and requires Custom Longitudinal plus the research actuation gate; Monitor only makes no driving changes.

items.title: Map Coast
items.description: Monitor early lift-off points toward map-known slowdowns (curves, lower limits) beyond camera range, or apply them as coast-only speed shaping. Apply mode only eases off — it never brakes on map data — and requires Custom Longitudinal, the Map curve source, plus the research actuation gate; Monitor only makes no driving changes.

items.title: Scenario Context
items.description: Shadow-only classification of the current driving scene for route-log analysis. No driving changes.

items.title: Longitudinal Debug Trace
items.description: Add structured custom longitudinal diagnostics to route logs. Logging only; no driving changes.

items.title: Allow Longitudinal Research Actuation
items.description: Enables apply/gate behavior for non-baseline longitudinal research features, such as radar-only cut-in promotion and experimental lead, curve, cut-in, and standstill release gates. Off keeps those features monitor-only or inactive.

items.title: Cut-in Brake Assist
items.description: Monitor close cut-in style lead events, or apply a bounded gentle braking cap when a close cut-in is detected. Apply mode can add gentle braking; Off returns to the base behavior. Requires Custom Longitudinal and is disabled when longitudinal is off.

items.title: Curve Speed Confidence
items.description: Monitor SCC curve evidence, or apply a conservative final accel cap when confidence is high.

items.title: Curve Traffic Advisor
items.description: Logs curve shape and traffic context for route validation. Apply conservative can add a bounded braking cap before model-predicted curves when confidence is high and traffic gates are clear.

items.title: Standstill Release Confidence
items.description: Monitor launch-release evidence, or let the stopped-lead latch release earlier when the same lead is clearly pulling away.

items.title: Disengage Cruise on Accelerator Pedal
items.description: When enabled, pressing the accelerator pedal will disengage longitudinal control. Turn it off to keep the default accelerator override behavior.

items.title: Driving Personality
items.description: Standard is recommended. In aggressive mode, sunnypilot will follow lead cars closer and be more aggressive with the gas and brake. In relaxed mode sunnypilot will stay further away from lead cars. On supported cars, you can cycle through these personalities with your steering wheel distance button.

items.title: Intelligent Cruise Button Management (ICBM) (Alpha)
items.description: Emulates built-in cruise-control button presses for limited longitudinal control. This can change how cruise speed is adjusted; turn it off to return button behavior to the vehicle stock path.

items.title: Enable Custom ACC Speed Intervals
items.description: Change short- and long-press cruise speed increments. Disable to return to the default increments.

sub_items.title: Short Press Increment
sub_items.description: Speed change applied to each short cruise-speed button press while custom intervals are enabled.

sub_items.title: Long Press Increment
sub_items.description: Speed change applied to each long cruise-speed button press while custom intervals are enabled.

sections.title: Speed Limits
sections.description: Speed limit detection and offset behavior

items.title: Vision
items.description: Use vision path predictions to estimate the appropriate speed to drive through turns ahead.

items.title: Map
items.description: Use map data to estimate the appropriate speed to drive through turns ahead.

items.title: Custom Longitudinal
items.description: Shape the stock longitudinal planner with the custom-2.0 policy for smoother launches and lead-following. It only shapes within the planner's safety envelope and never relaxes braking; off uses the stock planner.

sub_items.title: Longitudinal Mode
sub_items.description: Select the custom longitudinal policy mode while offroad. ACC keeps cruise + lead behavior, E2E relies on model stops/slowdowns, and SCC blends both.

panels.label: Display
panels.description: Screen brightness, timeout, and interactivity settings

sections.title: Brightness & Timeout
sections.description: Screen dimming and sleep behavior while driving

items.title: Interactivity Timeout
items.description: Apply a custom timeout for settings UI. This is the time after which settings UI closes automatically if user is not interacting with the screen.

panels.label: Visuals
panels.description: HUD overlays, alerts, and on-screen display elements

sections.title: HUD Elements
sections.description: Overlays shown on the driving screen

items.title: Show Blind Spot Warnings
items.description: Enabling this will display warnings when a vehicle is detected in your blind spot as long as your car has BSM supported.

items.title: Steering Arc
items.description: Display steering arc on the driving screen when lateral control is enabled.

items.title: Display Turn Signals
items.description: When enabled, visual turn indicators are drawn on the HUD.

items.title: Display Road Name
items.description: Displays the name of the road the car is traveling on. The OpenStreetMap database of the location must be downloaded to fetch the road name.

items.title: Standstill Timer
items.description: Show a timer on the HUD when the car is at a standstill.

items.title: Real-time Acceleration Bar
items.description: Show an indicator on the left side of the screen to display real-time vehicle acceleration and deceleration. This displays what the car is currently doing, not what the planner is requesting.

items.title: Developer UI
items.description: Display real-time parameters and metrics from various sources.

items.title: Speedometer: Always Display True Speed
items.description: For applicable vehicles, always display the true vehicle current speed from wheel speed sensors.

items.title: Speedometer: Hide from Onroad Screen
items.description: When enabled, the speedometer on the onroad screen is not displayed.

sections.title: Alerts & Extras
sections.description: Traffic light alerts and visual flair

items.title: Green Traffic Light Alert (Beta)
items.description: A chime and on-screen alert will play when the traffic light you are waiting for turns green and you have no vehicle in front of you. On-screen visual alert is only available on comma 3X. Note: This chime is only designed as a notification. It is the driver's responsibility to observe their environment and make decisions accordingly.

items.title: Lead Departure Alert (Beta)
items.description: A chime and on-screen alert will play when you are stopped, and the vehicle in front of you start moving. On-screen visual alert is only available on comma 3X. Note: This chime is only designed as a notification. It is the driver's responsibility to observe their environment and make decisions accordingly.

items.title: Tesla Rainbow Mode
items.description: Display a rainbow effect on the path the model wants to take. It does not affect driving in any way.

items.title: Enable sunnypilot
items.description: Use the sunnypilot system for adaptive cruise control and lane keep driver assistance. Your attention is required at all times to use this feature.

items.title: Enable Lane Departure Warnings
items.description: Receive alerts to steer back into the lane when your vehicle drifts over a detected lane line without a turn signal activated while driving over 31 mph (50 km/h).

items.title: Always-On Driver Monitoring
items.description: Enable driver monitoring even when sunnypilot is not engaged.

items.title: Use Metric System
items.description: Display speed in km/h instead of mph.

sections.title: Recording
sections.description: Camera and audio recording during drives

items.title: Record and Upload Driver Camera
items.description: Upload data from the driver facing camera and help improve the driver monitoring algorithm.

items.title: Record and Upload Microphone Audio
items.description: Record and store microphone audio while driving. The audio will be included in the dashcam video in comma connect.

panels.label: Device
panels.description: Device behavior, units, and recording settings

items.title: Wake Up Behavior
items.description: Controls state of the device after boot/sleep. Default: Device will boot/wake-up normally and will be ready to engage. Offroad: Device will be in Always Offroad mode after boot/wake-up.

items.title: Max Time Offroad
items.description: Device will automatically shutdown after set time once the engine is turned off. 30h is the default.

panels.label: OpenStreetMap
panels.description: Offline map downloads and database updates

items.description: Updates are only downloaded while the car is off.

items.title: Disable Updates
items.description: When enabled, software updates will be off. This requires a reboot to take effect.

items.title: Enable sunnylink
items.description: This is the master switch, it will allow you to cutoff any sunnylink requests should you want to do that.

items.title: Sponsor Status
items.description: Become a sponsor of sunnypilot to get early access to sunnylink features when they become available.

items.title: Pair GitHub Account
items.description: Pair your GitHub account to grant your device sponsor benefits, including API access on sunnylink.

items.title: Enable sunnylink uploader (infrastructure test)
items.description: Enable sunnylink uploader to allow sunnypilot to upload your driving data to sunnypilot servers. (Only for highest tiers, and does NOT bring ANY benefit to you yet. We are just testing data volume.)

panels.label: Developer
panels.description: Debug tools, remote access, and advanced services

items.title: Enable ADB
items.description: ADB (Android Debug Bridge) allows connecting to your device over USB or over the network. See https://docs.comma.ai/how-to/connect-to-comma for more info.

items.title: sunnypilot Longitudinal Control (Alpha)
items.description: WARNING: sunnypilot longitudinal control is in alpha for this car and will disable Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB). On this car, sunnypilot defaults to the car's built-in ACC instead of sunnypilot's longitudinal control. Enable this to switch to sunnypilot longitudinal control. Enabling Experimental mode is recommended when enabling sunnypilot longitudinal control alpha. Changing this setting will restart sunnypilot if the car is powered on.

sections.title: Test Maneuvers
sections.description: DANGER: enabling these maneuvers replaces normal driving behavior with deterministic test sequences. Each toggle requires explicit confirmation per write. Use only in a closed environment.

items.title: [TEST] Lateral Maneuver Mode
items.description: Replaces normal lateral control with a deterministic test sequence. NOT for road use.

items.title: [TEST] Longitudinal Maneuver Mode
items.description: Replaces normal longitudinal control with a deterministic test sequence. NOT for road use.

items.title: Show Advanced Controls
items.description: Toggle visibility of advanced sunnypilot controls. This only changes the visibility of the toggles; it does not change the actual enabled/disabled state.

items.title: GitHub Runner Service
items.description: Enables or disables the GitHub runner service.

items.title: copyparty Service
items.description: copyparty is a local file server that lets you view and download route and crash logs from a browser that can reach the device on port 8080 while offroad. It is unauthenticated and read-only while enabled.

items.title: Error Log
items.description: View the error log for sunnypilot crashes.

items.title: Tailscale VPN
items.description: Download and manage the Tailscale VPN binary for remote SSH access.

items.title: Enable Tailscale
items.description: Start the Tailscale daemon for always-on VPN connectivity.

items.title: Tailscale Login
items.description: Authentication required. Tap LOGIN to pair this device.

items.title: Tailscale Logout
items.description: Log out of Tailscale. You will need to re-authenticate to reconnect.

panels.label: Models
panels.description: Driving model behavior and camera calibration

sections.title: Model Behavior
sections.description: Lane desire and lead-vehicle awareness tuning

items.title: Use Lane Turn Desires
items.description: If you are driving at 20 mph (32 km/h) or below and have your blinker on, the car will plan a turn in that direction at the nearest drivable path. This changes model path intent at low speed; turn it off if the planned path looks wrong.

items.title: Adjust Lane Turn Speed
items.description: Set the maximum speed where lane turn desires may be used. Raising this can make the model plan turn-like paths at higher speeds.

items.title: Live Learning Steer Delay
items.description: Allow device to learn and adapt car's steering response time. Disable to use the fixed software delay below.

items.title: Adjust Software Delay
items.description: Adjust the fixed software delay when Live Learning Steer Delay is off. Wrong delay can make steering response feel early or late; default is 0.2 s.

items.title: Adjust Camera Offset
items.description: Virtually shift camera perspective to move the model center left (+ values) or right (- values). Non-zero offsets can bias the perceived path; return to 0 if lane centering looks worse.

items.title: Stop and Go for Manual Parking Brake (Beta)
Enforce Factory Longitudinal Control
items.description: sunnypilot will not take over control of gas and brakes. Factory Toyota longitudinal control will be used.

items.title: TSS2 Smooth Longitudinal (Beta)
items.description: Use a softer Toyota TSS2 longitudinal tune for smoother traffic following and stops. This changes gas and brake tuning only; steering is unchanged.

items.title: Stop and Go Hack (Alpha)
items.description: sunnypilot will allow some Toyota/Lexus cars to auto resume during stop and go traffic. This feature is only applicable to certain models that are able to use longitudinal control. This is an alpha feature. Use at your own risk.
